So basically, we are the biggest, I would say, technical association, a lot of members all over the world. And from the technical point of view, we cover technologies from early stage, electrical engineering from... Tesla and Edison, who founded IEEE more than 130 years ago, to now more emerging technologies like artificial intelligence, blockchain and quantum. These are basically the most important ones that we are looking at. But basically, as we all know, all the input data like voice, DNA, gate, emotions or IP addresses can be used for tracking. Not everybody is aware of that. The second phase is, of course, the aggregation. So this input data is aggregated with other data from other users or objective data like weather data or traffic data. And as we all know, systems are very good to detect correlations between data. So based on this correlation, certain hypothesis is built up, which ultimately builds up our profile or what I also hear now digital phenotype. But again, is this something that I would like to have individually?
